name: Read aloud
pick: People read sentences aloud and record them: a read-speech corpus, possibly in several emotions or speaking styles.
summary: Read short sentences aloud and record them.
suggest: Read each sentence happy, sad and angry
examples: each sentence in happy and sad voice

prompts: The sun came out after lunch.
Tomorrow will be cold and windy.

settings.consent: I agree that my recordings and the information I give are stored and used to build a speech dataset for research.
settings.title: Read sentences aloud
settings.instructions: Find a quiet place and use headphones if you can. Read each sentence aloud in the way asked, then listen to it before you submit.
prompts: The meeting starts at ten o'clock tomorrow.
Please close the window before you leave.
My sister bought a new bicycle last week.
Could you tell me the way to the station?
